items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think somebody wrote a song. I don’t know if it was Fletcher Henderson or who.

ctx.x: Well, what’s it worth? Iraq. That’s where we – we were a wreck in Iraq, really.
I think somebody wrote a song. I don’t know if it was Fletcher Henderson or who.
But that was ordained to happen. That sent me back to Cincinnati . . .
